content:
Content type
Content type
Creates an evaluation account.
Requires ADMINISTRATOR [64] user permissions. See Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
string
The name of the customer account.
Array of strings (Licensed-Apps)
An array of strings defining the list of licensed Tenable applications
For example, ["vm", "was", "lumin"] . Valid strings include the
following:
ad—Tenable Identity Exposure
asm—Tenable Attack Surface Management
lumin—Tenable Lumin
one—Tenable One
vm—Tenable Vulnerability Management
was—Tenable Web App Scanning
string
The default email address used for contacting the owner of the
evaluation account. The domain name of the email address must
match the MSSP partner's domain name.
string
A unique username for the evaluation account. It must be in email
format, ex. customer@partner.com , and the domain name of the
email address must match the MSSP partner's domain name.
string
The primary contact's country in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. Valid
country codes are AU , BR , CA , EU , IN , JP , SG , UK , and
US .
